messages.author: 022bdb23a51c8bdf
messages.subject: spacing and 2 column in beamer
parts:
Dear Group,

I've 2 questions:

1. How can I reduce the spacing between R-code and R-output.
I've tried
\begin{tiny}
<<size="tiny", ...
but I've git the impression that this does not reduce the linespread
between R-code and R output.
How can I reduce that?
2. I use beamer (and lyx) and would like to have two columns - code on
the left and a plot on the right at one slide
How can do this?

regards,
René

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] spacing and 2 column in beamer
parts:
1. font size and linespread are definitely two different things, so it
is not surprising. To change the line spacing, you can use the
setspace package, e.g. add this to your preamble:

\usepackage{setspace}

\ifdefined\knitrout
\renewenvironment{knitrout}{\begin{spacing}{1.1}\begin{tiny}}{\end{tiny}\end{spacing}}
\else
\fi

2. I have not tried, but you can probably use two identical chunks;
one shows the code only and the other shows the plot only, e.g.

<<foo-plot, eval=FALSE, echo=TRUE>>=
par(mar=c(4, 4, .1, .1))
plot(1)
@

<<foo-plot, eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE>>=
@

see http://yihui.name/knitr/demo/reference/

Regards,
Yihui

The other possibility is to redefine the output hooks (you always have
this freedom of customization); the default hooks are defined in
https://github.com/yihui/knitr/blob/master/R/hooks.R#L281

See http://yihui.name/knitr/hooks
